## 2025-05-22 - [CSS Injection in Chart Component]
**Vulnerability:** The `ChartStyle` component in `src/components/ui/chart.tsx` was injecting unsanitized user-provided IDs and configuration keys directly into a `<style>` tag using `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.
**Learning:** Even internal-looking IDs (like those generated by `useId`) can be overridden by users via props, leading to attribute breakout or CSS rule injection if not properly sanitized or quoted.
**Prevention:** Always sanitize dynamic content injected into `<style>` tags. Use restrictive regex for IDs and keys, and strictly block breakout characters (`; { } [ ] " < > \`) in CSS values. Quote attribute selectors (e.g., `[data-chart="${id}"]`) to prevent attribute breakout.
